summary: Changes an earlier ordinance so Metro accepts about 1,852 feet of six-inch sewer force main instead of about 2,152 feet, which is 300 feet less, for Nolensville Town Square - Phase 1 Revision 1 at 7375 Nolensville Road in Williamson County. The rest of the sewer pump station, mains, manholes and easements being accepted stays the same.
